what the app does today: Names one of four cases on most paths.
proposed behavior: Keep: say which case it is - a true zero; something no dataset collects; a place or period outside what is held; or an app failure. A verified zero is shown as 0, never blank (for one agency a month reported as zero crimes is not a verified zero: P121), and a failure is never presented as missing data.
